panels.description: Stacked CPU time by mode; the stack adds up to 100 %. user, system, iowait and steal are measured; other = busy − (user + system + iowait + steal), i.e. nice, irq and softirq; idle = 100 − busy. RDS with Enhanced Monitoring: all modes (busy = EM cpuUtilization.total). RDS without Enhanced Monitoring: CloudWatch CPUUtilization only, shown as "busy (no mode split)" + idle. Supabase and ClickHouse: per-mode CPU seconds. Self-managed: no host_* series, empty.

panels.title: CPU utilization

panels.description: Stacked memory; the stack adds up to total RAM (dashed line). With free, cached and buffers (RDS with Enhanced Monitoring, Supabase): used = total − free − cached − buffers, then buffers, cached, free. ClickHouse (no free or buffers): used = total − available, then available. RDS without Enhanced Monitoring: only CloudWatch FreeableMemory ("available"); total RAM is unknown, so the stack has no reference line. Swap is not part of RAM and is a separate line. The largest process RSS (RDS with Enhanced Monitoring only) is a dashed line, not part of the stack.
